title: Salvianolic acid C alleviates acute kidney injury by restoring fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase 1-mediated gluconeogenesis.
authors: Chen, Jianing; Li, Yujie; Zhou, Peihui; Zou, Shanshan; Zhao, Jiaqi; Wu, Ming; Wang, Li
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物SAC通过FBP1介导糖异生缓解急性肾损伤，虽含分子对接但核心为肾损伤药理机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: This research was targeted to investigate the pharmacological effects and mechanisms of Salvianolic acid C (SAC), a natural compound extracted from the Chinese traditional herbal Danshen (Salviae Miltiorrhizae Radix et Rhizoma), in acute kidney injury (AKI). Male C57BL/6J mice were used to create animal models and SAC (10 mg/kg, i.p.) or saline was administered 24 h before modeling. In both ischemia reperfusion injury (IRI) induced AKI and cisplatin (Cis) induced AKI models, SAC significantly alleviated the decline of renal function and destruction of renal pathological structure, which were correlated with reduced expression of renal injury markers and inhibited renal cell apoptosis. Non-targeted metabolomics sequencing revealed that the gluconeogenesis pathway was downstream of the renal protective effect of SAC in AKI. Further experiments revealed that the expression of key gluconeogenic enzyme fructose-1,6-bisphosphatase 1 (FBP1) was significantly decreased in AKI kidneys. AKI induced the reduction in glucose levels from serum and increase in lactate levels from serum and renal tissue. All of these metabolic changes were improved after the SAC treatment. The protective effects of SAC were reversed by an FBP1 inhibitor. Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma coactivator 1-alpha (PGC1alpha) and forkhead box O1 (FOXO1), identified as gluconeogenesis promoting factor, were decreased after injection of cisplatin, which were reversed by SAC. Finally, molecular docking and SPR experiments revealed the direction interaction between FBP1 and SAC. Collectively, SAC possibly exerts its effect through a dual regulatory mechanism: by modulating the FOXO1/PGC1alpha/FBP1 signaling axis and via direct interaction with FBP1.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨丹酚酸C（SAC）——一种从中药丹参（Salviae Miltiorrhizae Radix et Rhizoma）中提取的天然化合物——在急性肾损伤（AKI）中的药理作用及其机制。使用雄性C57BL/6J小鼠建立动物模型，并在建模前24小时给予SAC（10 mg/kg，腹腔注射）或生理盐水。在缺血再灌注损伤（IRI）诱导的AKI和顺铂（Cis）诱导的AKI模型中，SAC显著缓解了肾功能下降和肾病理结构破坏，这与肾损伤标志物表达减少及肾细胞凋亡抑制相关。非靶向代谢组学测序揭示，糖异生通路是SAC在AKI中肾脏保护作用的下游靶点。进一步实验显示，关键糖异生酶果糖-1,6-二磷酸酶1（FBP1）在AKI肾脏中表达显著降低。AKI诱导血清中葡萄糖水平下降，以及血清和肾组织中乳酸水平升高。所有这些代谢变化在SAC处理后均得到改善。SAC的保护作用可被FBP1抑制剂逆转。过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ共激活因子1-α（PGC1alpha）和叉头框蛋白O1（FOXO1）——被鉴定为糖异生促进因子——在注射顺铂后表达降低，而SAC可逆转这一变化。最后，分子对接和SPR实验揭示了FBP1与SAC之间的直接相互作用。综上，SAC可能通过双重调控机制发挥其作用：通过调节FOXO1/PGC1alpha/FBP1信号轴，以及通过与FBP1的直接相互作用。
